title: bug: concurrent keystore test oracle is incomplete
description: test_keystore_concurrent_write_read() in wp11_test_keystore.c checks bad_count==0 and writer_result==0 but never asserts that the reader thread made any attempts (ok_count + error_count > 0). If the reader thread is never scheduled, the test passes trivially with all counts at zero. This means thread-safety is not actually exercised by the test. Fix: add check((reader_result.ok_count + reader_result.error_count) > 0, 'concurrent reader executed at least one iteration').
